ModMetaData.name: Witcher Base
ModMetaData.author: Tristan
ModMetaData.description:
The foundation mod for a modular Witcher content suite. Adds the Witcher trials to RimWorld Biotech.
Research three trials to transform colonists into witchers: - Trial of Grasses: a brutal initiation. Anyone can attempt it, but boys aged 8-12 have the best odds (about 30% survive; others rarely do). Survivors gain disease resistance, robustness, fast healing, dark vision, sterility, faster movement, and ugly features. - Trial of Dreams: a follow-up trial for witcher initiates. About 70% survive. Survivors gain reduced sleep, pain resistance, dead calm, fast learning, dulled senses, low social impact, and slow aging. - Additional Mutagens: a perilous upgrade (about 10% survive) that pushes a witcher's existing gifts to their extreme tier.
All trials are performed from the Health tab and consume herbal ingredients. Each trial induces a painful fever lasting one to two days; the outcome is sealed once the trial begins, and those who fail do not survive.
The Trial of Mountains research is included as a placeholder for a future quest-based final trial.
Requires Biotech.
